people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
translations.bsb: “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
translations.kjv: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.
translations.asv: For I, Jehovah, change not; therefore ye, O sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
